deliverer: the frozen mere (4 s of cracks, then burst through the ice)
scatter: polar disc r 8 m about the anchor (oracle: theta = 2 pi u1, rho = 8 u2); every 'ground' segment covers it

camera.law: screen_x = ppm*x ; screen_y = ppm*sin(a)*y - ppm*cos(a)*z (sim frame: x east, y SOUTH, z up)
camera.runtime_scale_rule: draw each cell UNROTATED with its pivot_px on the projected pivot point, scaled by s = proj.ppm / px_per_m (the JOIN rule; at ZOOM-GD proj.ppm = 75.668)

playback.reveal: uniform progress = clamp((t_now - t_event) / build_s, 0, 1); hold at 1

segments.draw_layer: ground: above the painted floor, BELOW every y-sorted actor

events.start: EV_AMBUSH_HOLD_START(p05) = the p05 ProxyAmbush release (am1: bodies absent 0 -> 4.0 s, P05_FIRST_ARRIVAL_S): progress = (t - t0) / 4.0
events.hold: progress held at 1 from t0 + 4.0 (the cracks are fully open as the bodies burst)
events.end: fade 1 -> 0 over 2.0 s from the LAST p05 body's EV_AM5_TIMEOUT; then free

segments.reveal_encoding: reveal_map.r = arrival / build_s (0..1, 8-bit; 1.0 = never); a pixel shows once progress passes it; the front carries a short pale glint
segments.build_curve: slow hairlines from the middle (0-1 s), the rim joins (1.1-2 s), spreading (2.3-3.1 s), a flurry of short cracks everywhere (3.3-3.9 s)

draw_layer.ysort_ground_m: the body's own landing point + 0.05 m south (drawn just in front of its own body)

events.start: EV_AMBUSH_ARRIVAL(body, x, y) = the body's p05 spawn at t0 + 4.0 s: frame 0 on that tick (dense: it covers the pop-in; the health bar shows from the same frame per the Sim Session's footage read)
events.end: free on the last frame (0.75 s; fits inside the shortest am3 window, D_long 0.867 s)
events.scale: x max(1, record_radius_m / 0.8) for wide bodies

segments.draw_layer: ground: above the painted floor, BELOW every y-sorted actor

events.start: EV_AMBUSH_ARRIVAL(body, x, y): intro from frame 0 (under the body; the burst plays over it)
events.hold: loop for the record's am3 window D: until EV_AM5_TIMEOUT(body) = arrival + D_long_s(record) (STRETCHABLE: D is per RECORD -- engine pack v3.11 model/waves.json '⚑ v3p8_rows'.am3_emergence_window, key monster.p05_emergence_window_s, value.D_long_s; 31 rows V38-AM3-*; 0.867 .. 4.9 s; ticks ceil(t / period - 1e-9))
events.end: at EV_AM5_TIMEOUT(body) (the body starts moving) fade modulate.a 1 -> 0 over 1.0 s; then free
events.parameter: D = value.D_long_s of the body's record (NOT D_short_s)

deliverer_feature: none: the mere itself delivers (the ambush)

ambush.hold_source: kc2_runtime/sim/kc2rt_fight.gd am1 P05_FIRST_ARRIVAL_S (via the conductor relay)
ambush.am3_D_source: engine pack kc2-model-pack-v3-E-s09-cp150-mech-v3p11 model/waves.json '⚑ v3p8_rows'.am3_emergence_window value.D_long_s
ambush.only_p05_emerges: p01-p04 and p06 release ring bodies with NO emergence; their arrivals are a cover-the-pop one-shot
